fol.notes: housed_in is a function (RELATIONS.md: functional; an artwork is housed in one museum at a time), over an enumeration of the named works and museums plus other_museum, so 'the same museum' is equality of the two works' housed_in values. Delete of a stored fact: after it the Mona Lisa's museum is open. The Winged Victory's museum is stored by name (q1's bridge). w1 stores The Wedding Feast at Cana under the Louvre by name; w2 stores it as hanging opposite the Mona Lisa, in the same room, so in the same museum, whichever it is.
